title: Dacy's Advancements
description: This data-pack adds advancements that I see fit to be in the base game
body:
This data-pack adds new advancements, These advancements may not be fit for hardcore challenges as some advamcements may give rewards upon obtaining them.

**Current number of advancements: 2**(Last updated: 25 June, 2026, if this date does not line up with the latest version's date, let me know)

This data-pack is unfinished, I have a target of 10 advancements being added by full release. Apologies for the wait you may have to take.
